bind_address.description: IP address for spampd to bind to (e.g., loopback or public interface)

bind_port.description: Port to listen on for incoming SMTP connections

spamc_host.description: Hostname or IP where SpamAssassin's spamc/spamd daemon listens

connect_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait when connecting to spamd

read_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for data from spamd after connection

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' for stderr)

user.description: Unix user to run the service as (for security)

group.description: Unix group to run the service as

pid_file.description: Path to PID file (set to '' or omit to disable)

max_children.description: Maximum number of concurrent child processes (connections)

skip_scanning_domains.description: List of domains to skip spam scanning for (e.g., internal mail)

custom_rules.description: Custom SpamAssassin rules or score adjustments

name.description: Option name (e.g., 'required_hits') or rule name for scoring

whitelist_senders.description: Email addresses or patterns to always trust (bypass spam scoring)

blacklist_senders.description: Email addresses or patterns to always treat as spam
